# Copilot (Microsoft)

Microsoft uses Copilot as a name in more than one sense, so each sense is its own link:

- **GitHub's family of agents:** GitHub Copilot, which are [agents][industry.agent] ([About Copilot in the cloud][m7]).
- **A VS Code harness:** Copilot, one of VS Code's [agent harnesses][industry.agent-harness] ([Build with agents][m3]).

Copilot also names the Copilot SDK, Copilot Studio and Microsoft's unrelated assistant products. It is not a [model][microsoft.model].
